in_marathi.name: Atira
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Shining, Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atira हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Atir' meaning 'radiant' or 'shining', Atira is a popular name among Hindus, symbolizing the divine light and power of the deities. It is a name for a girl who is believed to bring joy, prosperity, and enlightenment to her family and loved ones.
